data_description.device_type: Simple on/off device or device with variable power management

data.subscribe_to_events: Recalculate with every new Production/Consumption Value

data_description.refresh_period_sec: Even with no new data, refresh at least in with this period in seconds. Warning heavy calculations are done at each period, so keep an eye on the CPU load. Don't refresh to often
data_description.power_consumption_entity_id: The entity_id of the net power consumption sensor. Net power should be negative if power is exported to grid.
data_description.power_production_entity_id: The entity_id of the solar power production sensor.
data_description.subscribe_to_events: Subscribe to events to recalculate with new data, as soon as they are avalaible. Keep an eye on the CPU load.
data_description.sell_cost_entity_id: The entity_id which holds the current energy sell price.
data_description.buy_cost_entity_id: The entity_id which holds the current energy buy price.
data_description.sell_tax_percent_entity_id: The energy resell tax percent (0 to 100)
data_description.smooth_production: If checked, the solar production will be smoothed to avoid hard variation
data_description.battery_soc_entity_id: The entity id of the battery state of charge in %. If you don't have battery, keep it empty
data_description.battery_charge_power_entity_id: The entity id of the battery power net charging rate in watt. It should be negative if battery is charging and positive if battery is discharging. Keep it empty if no solar battery is used.
data_description.battery_power_strategy: Existing behavior retains the upstream optimizer. Charge battery first preserves the configured minimum charging rate. Charge first with battery budget also lets an already-running flexible load use the battery after the upper SOC threshold is reached, until the lower threshold is reached.
data_description.battery_budget_start_soc: Upper SOC threshold that opens the battery budget. This must be greater than the close threshold.
data_description.battery_budget_stop_soc: Lower SOC threshold that closes the battery budget and prevents further flexible-load battery discharge.
data_description.maximum_battery_charge_reserve_power: Maximum charging reserve at and below the taper-start SOC.
data_description.battery_charge_reserve_start_soc: SOC where the full reserve applies. Above this value the minimum reserve falls in 10% SOC steps, then 5% steps between the close and open battery-budget thresholds.
data_description.minimum_export_power: Extra real grid export required before flexible loads can use surplus while the battery budget is closed.
data_description.decision_reversal_hold_sec: Seconds after an optimizer on/off command during which the opposite command is suppressed, allowing inverter and sensor readings to settle. The first decision and repeated decisions in the same direction remain immediate. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.raz_time: Time to reset active time counters. Should be before first exposure to sunlight but not too early to allow enough time for night activation

data_description.name: The name of the device
data_description.power_max: The power of the device when activated. Can be a number or a template
data_description.check_usable_template: The template to check if the device is usable. Example `True ` or `states('sensor.my_sensor') | float > 10` (don't forgeet double accolades)
data_description.check_active_template: The template to check if the device is active. Keep it empty for switch type device or apparented. Example `is_state_attr('sensor.my_sensor', 'hvac_mode', 'heat')` (with double accolades)
data_description.duration_min: The minimum duration of the device when turned on in minutes
data_description.duration_stop_min: The minimum duration of the device when turned off in minutes
data_description.action_mode: The action mode of the device. `service` to service call a service to turn on or off or `event` to send an event to turn on or off
data_description.activation_service: The service to activate the device. Example `switch/turn_on` or `climate/set_hvac_mode/hvac_mode:cool`
data_description.deactivation_service: The service to deactivate the device. Example `switch/turn_off` or `climate/set_hvac_mode/hvac_mode:off`. Keep it empty if the device will turn off by itself
data_description.battery_soc_threshold: The battery state of charge threshold to activate the device. Can be a number or a template
data_description.max_on_time_per_day_min: The maximum time per day in state on in minutes. Can be a number or a template. If minium time is not reached during daylight, it will be activated during offpeak time until max time is reached
data_description.min_on_time_per_day_min: The minimum time per day in state on in minutes. Can be a number or a template. If minium time is not reached during daylight, it will be activated during offpeak time
data_description.offpeak_time: The offpeak time with format HH:MM
